release_gates: Every required module has a source implementation, permission contract, tests and product integration.
All optional modules are either packaged and tested or explicitly marked unavailable without being silently removed.
The old Gradle launcher and newer Soong system apps are unified with one source of truth.
Exact RMX5566RU device tree, kernel, vendor blobs, HAL, VINTF, partitions and AVB inputs are verified.
MANA update package is signed, versioned independently and tested with rollback.
No update is labelled installable until it is tested on the exact target device.

release_policy.stock_realme_updater_integration: only when package is accepted by the OEM-supported trust and compatibility chain
release_policy.fallback_entrypoint: MANA recovery/installer after supported bootloader unlock
release_policy.one_tap_scope: one user confirmation to start a prevalidated update; no silent destructive flashing
release_policy.update_android_and_realme_base: track the newest firmware explicitly released for the exact RMX5566RU SKU; do not mix builds from other regions or devices
release_policy.status: requested UX; not yet implemented or flashable

system_authority.target: MANA Brain acts as the central system assistant and orchestrator across installed MANA services and explicitly granted Android capabilities
system_authority.privilege_model: maximum supported privileges through a deliberately built system image and declared privileged permissions, with SELinux policy and user-visible security boundaries
system_authority.reason: Android platform security, boot chain, hardware interfaces and legal permission boundaries cannot be truthfully represented as unrestricted authority
system_authority.requirement: every privileged capability must have an explicit service interface, policy, audit log and recovery behavior
